thread:
sara-b: Heads-up from FinSecure: they want a 2-week EU-only POC. Requirements: signed subprocessors list, a routing path statement for auditors, BYO-KMS pricing line, and a simple hosted vs dedicated cost delta. Can presales triage?
leo-se: Quick Qs: which model are they planning to validate? expected sustained RPS and max concurrency? Is encryption-at-rest with customer keys required for the POC or only for production?
sara-b: They're testing rwd-gpt-small first. Target ~15 RPS sustained, occasional spikes to 60 for batch jobs. BYO-KMS is required for production; for POC they want it optioned on the quote. Auditor specifically wants a diagram showing no data leaves EU and an operations statement.
tom-ops: We can pin tenant to EU regions; recommended for strict residency is eu-central-1 or eu-west-1. Current subprocessor roster we disclose: AWS (EC2, S3), Fastly (CDN), Sentry, Datadog. I can export that with our SOC2/ISO links.
tom-ops: Draft routing statement we can provide: "With tenant pinning enabled, control-plane traffic and inference payloads are constrained to the selected EU region(s). No cross-border inference egress will be performed by Redwood's runtime for pinned tenants." Need Legal sign-off on attestation.
maria-sales: On pricing: Hosted POC (no commit) estimate includes model compute + short-term egress premium ~€0.04/token overhead. Dedicated (reserved) shows lower egress ~€0.01/token but requires commit; BYO-KMS setup fee €1,500 + per-token key usage fee €0.010. I'll add these to the quote doc.
leo-se: Can we also give them a sample config to show how pinning and fallback are turned off? Auditors like to see the enforcement knobs.
tom-ops: Sample config we can share:
```json
{"tenant":"finsecure-poc","region_pin":"eu-central-1","geofence":true,"fallback":"disabled"}
```
sara-b: Who's taking Legal for the signed attestation and subprocessor disclose?
maria-sales: I'll coordinate with Legal and Compliance. Tom, please upload the subproc export + cert links to the deal folder so Legal has the artifacts.
compliance-bot: artifact note: subproc_inventory_finsecure_2024-06-18 uploaded by tom-ops
tom-ops: Uploaded the inventory and SOC/ISO links. Action items: (1) tom-ops -> network diagram + subproc export (done); (2) maria-sales -> legal attestation kickoff; (3) leo-se -> update POC quote with BYO-KMS + cost lines; (4) sara-b -> schedule customer kickoff after attestation. ETA 48h.
maria-sales: Kicking Legal now, will post ETA here.
sara-b: Thanks everyone, will pause the customer call until attestation is signed.
